note: Labelled cases for the relevance classifier. Every entry is a REAL posting this pipeline has seen, with the answer a human would give. Sourced from the incidents recorded in classify.ts's own comments - each one is a bug that reached production or nearly did, so its correct answer is documented rather than guessed. Add a case whenever a new failure is found; that is how this file earns its keep.
